questions.question: Is all other equipment onsite properly inspected before work starts each day and free of visible leaks, damage or other unsafe conditions?  (Include pictures of at least five additional equipment inspections)

Do all workers have training certificates on file for the equipment they are operating and have appropriate stickers on their helmet?  (Include pictures of at least five workers displaying training stickers)
Is anyone operating mobile, motorized equipment using a seatbelt during operation of the equipment?
